teacher_info.teaching_style:
I tend to focus my lessons on three main aspects: grammar, pronunciation and practice. It much depends on my students’ level, but I would typically start a course with phonetics as I believe it is essential not only to get yourself understood, but also to understand others. I try to make grammar the most fun possible making a massive use of drill exercises that will enable students to use the language without too much thinking.
Because I don’t want to make my students feel uneasy I try to be easygoing when I teach them and avoid putting too much pressure on them.
I specialise in Cambridge certificates, Italian language certificates and I have a good knowledge of business English and Italian.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
I’ve taught hundreds of students over the past years and the most important thing I’ve discovered is that we tend to avoid real "learning" by doing exercising which give us an illusion of competence and make us lose a lot of time and as a consequence thereof we tend to get frustrated and soon after we are likely to give up. I think, this is one of the main reasons of our failure in language acquisition. 
I believe, one of the best remedy to this problem is that the teacher and the student learn together and since real “learning” is tiring, we don’t have much time at our disposal due to the activities of daily living, I developed a method that is effective and efficient at the same time.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
Every section (50 min.) aims at improving fluency, enhancing vocabulary and new language structures or filling in your linguistic gaps.
- 10 Minutes: casual conversation about anything. While we talk, I note down your mistakes which we are going to discuss in the second part. 
- 10 minutes: we are going through the new words that came up during our conversation and learn them immediately by putting them in a context.
- 20 minutes: conversation about articles I’ve prepared. 
- 10 minutes: We’re going to either read or watch something so that you can improve your comprehension skill.But it's not that easy...
Please send me a message to check availability, before sending me a booking request.

pro_course_detail.title: Inglese
pro_course_detail.description:
Lo studio di una lingua prevede l´ampliamento del vocabolario, la conoscenza della grammatica, la pratica di conversazione ma in particolar modo lo sviluppo di una consapevolezza linguistica che inciderà positivamente sulla capacità di esporre in modo chiaro il proprio pensiero e automaticamente migliorerà la capacità di comprensione. La ripetizione spaziata e il richiamo attivo delle conoscenze, due sistemi didattici fondamentali nell´apprendimento linguistico, favoriranno lo sviluppo di un´autonomia nello studio della disciplina da parte dello studente oltre a consolidare l´acquisizione di un metodo di studio adeguato e ordinato.
L´obiettivo è favorire lo sviluppo di una motivazione intrinseca che porti l' apprendente a un coinvolgimento spontaneo alla materia oggetto di studio. Favorendo l´apprendimento come un processo attivo piuttosto che come un passivo assorbimento di conoscenze si cercherà di stimolare la creazione di un interesse individuale in grado di favorire nello studente un senso di autoefficacia e autoregolazione. Si evidenzierà il fatto che la motivazione spesso non è la causa dell´impegno in una determinata disciplina, ma la conseguenza dell´imparare abitudini di lavoro (il famoso “metodo”) che aiuteranno lo studente ad avere più fiducia in se stesso, ad essere più incline a mettersi alla prova e in definitiva a sentirsi più motivato ad apprendere. 
In ogni parte ci si focalizzerà sempre sul confronto con la propria lingua madre in modo da facilitare l´apprendimento. Per attuare tale confronto utilizzerò con frequenza Office in modo da rendere ordinata la lezione, sfavorendo ogni eventuale dispersione di conoscenza. 
La costanza che verrà dedicata alla ripetizione dilazionata delle nuove conoscenze e di quelle già acquisite consentirà di graduare l´impegno dell' apprendente e allo stesso tempo favorire una sedimentazione delle conoscenze nella memoria a lungo termine.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
I am a positive, friendly and bubbly person, who really enjoys languages and correct grammar. But most of all, one who enjoys making English fun to learn. The first thing learners will notice about me is my rapport with the students; I believe it is the most important ingredient in making a lesson successful and the learner feel at ease. During my lessons, I make sure that the student's progress and understanding are my priority. I use visual and audio materials, and I always prompt a discussion to encourage the student to participate and enjoy the topic.
I focus a lot on practice, particularly repetition and pronunciation. 
I encourage students to speak and to learn to correct themselves.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
I begin with a quick, casual conversation with simple questions and answers (weather, or weekend activities). My lesson plans are normally centred on skills and a specific focus: speaking/writing, for example, with vocabulary/grammar etc. I aim to keep my speaking time to a minimum, and encourage students to speak as much as possible. I am happy using course-book material as well as authentic sources, suitably graded to the students' level.
I always present a variety of sources to keep lessons dynamic: audio files, texts, comprehension questionnaires (True/False, gap-fill). I end my lessons with language feedback, encouraging self-correction.
Students are encouraged to practise at home.

My experience is beneficial to understanding how to best approach non-native English speakers, conduct a conversation successfully and making yourself clear.

pro_course_detail.title: Speaking
pro_course_detail.description:
In my Speaking lessons, we will have the opportunity to use topics of various interest: latest news, films, books, holidays.
We will initiate a first, general discussion (opinions, Q&A).
Based on that topic, you will prepare notes, ideas: think about what you will say later.
I will then give you a Language Preparation model, in order to help you with how to say what you want to say (specific phrases, key vocabulary, grammatical structures, expressions). We will work on the pronunciation of any new vocabulary, and make sure that its meaning and form are absolutely clear to you.
You will have some time to prepare your thoughts, and then we will talk about the topic in question. 
After that, we will analyse key elements of our discussion, and I will give you language feedback to build your confidence in your speaking ability, by highlighting your successful language use, and correcting any errors you may have made.

pro_course_detail.title: Listening
pro_course_detail.description:
In a Listening lesson, you will focus entirely on understanding information coming from another speaker. You will extract general and detailed information, and train your ear to pick up specific words, phrases, and accents. This may include both British and American English, regional variants and - for more advanced levels - even slang.

The lesson begins with a short lead topic, based on the audio on which the lesson focuses.
We will then set the context of the listening task, and look at some essential vocabulary which you may need in order to help you with the audio track.
You will listen to the audio at least twice. We will play it at different speeds, starting with a faster speed, and going slower until it reaches the level you are most comfortable with.
At the first listening, concentrate on the general meaning of the audio, and do not worry about understanding every word or sentence. You will only answer a general question, to make sure that the subject of the audio is clear to you.
The second time, you will answer a number of more detailed questions about the audio, so listen more carefully in order to be able to pick up more of what you are listening to.
The audio track may have just one accent, or different accents. You will train your ear to identify different English-speaking accents over the course of our lessons.
The lesson concludes with a practice, either a Speaking or Writing task about the content of the audio, and making use of any specific language that it may require.

pro_course_detail.title: Writing
pro_course_detail.description:
In a Writing Lesson, we will look at models of writing, styles and useful phrases in an organised and logical structure, so that you can produce your own written text with minimal effort. This is particularly helpful for your business needs (emails, presentations, meetings), or for your academic skills. But it can also help you to write about anything else, from an email to a friend, to a job application or a Company presentation.
The lesson will use a text which will serve as your model of writing (for example, a book/film review, an email, a business pitch). You will analyse the content, the style, the genre, and identify the key elements of the kind of information that is included in it, as well as its language, whether it's formal, informal, conversational, or representative.
You will then use this information to create your own writing: What you will write; Who your writing is for, and Why you are writing it (what is its purpose). I will guide you with specific, useful phrases, vocabulary and other necessary tools for a successful writing task.
We will follow-up with analysing your writing, and comment and pick-up on your strengths and weaknesses, which are both important for you to understand how you can develop your skills.
